Description.OldValue: Specifies the type of the data held by the variable.
Description.NewValue: It specifies the type of the notification.

Description.OldValue: It refers to the type of data to be stored in the variable.
Description.NewValue: It takes the value for the notification type. Notification types can be Normal, Non-Dismissible, No-read, No-read-no-dismiss. The default value will always be Normal.
